relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: In real-world clinical practice, monoclonal antibodies against CGRP proved to be effective treatments in resistant migraine patients.

key_findings: In 155 refractory migraine patients (109 erenumab, 46 galcanezumab), 51.6% had >=50% migraine-day reduction at 12 weeks
